flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: Polymarket odds for Democratic control of the Senate rose by a sizable amount, and the Democrats remain the favoured party. In [[Iowa]], the Democrat Josh Turek gained ground by a sizable margin, and the market lists it as a predicted flip. [[Kansas]] is also shown as a predicted flip, with the Democrat Adam Hamilton making a moderate gain.
summaries.governor: In [[Kansas]], the Republican Ty Masterson saw a sizable drop in Polymarket odds, and the market now shows a predicted flip. Over in [[Ohio]], the Democrat Amy Acton gained moderate ground, which is also marked as a predicted flip. In [[Florida]], the Republican Byron Donalds strengthened sizably in the market's view.
summaries.house: The projected House count recently shifted to 241-194, up from 240-195, which would mean Democrats gain control. The change comes as [[CO-03 (Pueblo & Grand Junction)]] became a newly predicted flip, with the Democrat Dwayne Romero making a sharp gain in the market's view. In [[NC-13 (Fuquay-Varina & Sanford)]], the Republican Brad Knott also strengthened sharply.
